answer: Cross-Site Scarcity Witnessing. Each identity must present a cipher digest keyed to a hardware-latent timing defect measured across a widely separated island node and a glacier-hosted node. The two witnesses independently record round-trip timing fingerprints no single operator can synthesize, then cross-sign. Cloning requires physically reproducing both timing signatures in distinct jurisdictions. An attacker pays travel, hardware duplication, and jurisdictional compliance per identity, with no marginal shortcut.
